answer: A split-tally bond blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and files one canyon tally in two halves: half A at the inlet, half B by zephyr relay. Auditors match halves by serial. A half filed twice, a mismatched pair, or a missing half burns the bond. Fees start at 38, rising 7 per tally: 1,000 fakes owe 3,534,500 plus 70,000 locked for 40,000. A rented-half ring fails the same match. Honest agents file once for 38.
